steps.title: Sign in with LinkedIn
steps.body: You won't need a new password. Once you're in, the feed shows posts that other members have shared.

steps.title: Share one of your posts
steps.body: Paste the link to one of your LinkedIn posts. We add it to the feed so other members can see it.

steps.title: Join the conversation
steps.body: Pick a post. If you want, AI writes a first draft of your comment. Then we open the post on LinkedIn, where you react or comment yourself.

positioning.headline: What LISSI helps you do
positioning.intro: Link Into The SSI (LISSI) helps you get noticed on LinkedIn, work on your SSI, and stay in front of the people who matter in your field.

points.title: Get noticed on LinkedIn
points.body: Leave useful comments on posts from people in your field. The author sees your name, and so do the people reading the comments.

points.title: Improve your SSI
points.body: Engaging with posts is one of the four areas LinkedIn scores in your SSI. The feed gives you posts to engage with, and your weekly recap shows what you did.

points.title: Become known in your field
points.body: When people in your field keep seeing your name next to useful comments, they start to remember it.

points.title: Help the right people find you
points.body: Your next opportunity often comes from someone who already knows your work. Staying visible to them takes less effort than sending cold messages.

positioning.closing: You decide what to engage with, and you do it yourself on LinkedIn.

ssiExplainer.intro: LinkedIn's Social Selling Index (SSI) rates how you use LinkedIn on a scale of 0 to 100. It's made of four areas, each worth up to 25 points.

pillars.title: Establish your professional brand

items.q: Will Link Into The SSI post or comment for me?
items.a: No. We never post, react, or comment on LinkedIn for you. We open the post on LinkedIn and copy your comment draft if you have one. You finish the action there.

items.q: How is this different from automation tools?
items.a: Automation tools act from your account in bulk. With LISSI, you pick one post at a time, and you react or comment yourself on LinkedIn.

items.q: What does the free trial include, and when am I charged?
items.a: You get everything in the plan you choose, free for 7 days or until you reach 50 interactions, whichever comes first. Interactions are the reactions and comments you make, the first AI draft you create for each post, and the reactions and comments other members leave on your posts. You add a card to start, and we charge it when the trial ends. Cancel before then and you pay nothing.

items.q: What is the SSI, and how quickly will mine change?
items.a: The Social Selling Index (SSI) is LinkedIn's score from 0 to 100, built from four areas: your professional brand, finding the right people, engaging with insights, and building relationships. LinkedIn updates it every day. We can't see your score or predict it, so we don't promise a timeline. Since August 2026, LinkedIn only shows the SSI page to Sales Navigator users.

items.q: Do I need to be active every day?
items.a: No. Pick a pace you can keep up, even if that's a few comments a week.
Yes. Cancel from the Billing page in the app. There's no contract or cancellation fee, and you keep access until your current period ends.

items.q: How does Link Into The SSI help me get noticed on LinkedIn?
items.a: It gives you one feed of posts from your field and helps you write a good comment. You post each comment on LinkedIn, where the author and their readers see your name. You can also add your own posts to the feed so other members see them.

items.q: Can Link Into The SSI help me get a job faster?
items.a: It helps you stay visible to people in your field, and your next role often comes from someone who already knows your work. We can't promise a timeline or a specific result.
